otherWay.text: Capital spending was 2.4 times stock pay. The shortfall is mostly investment, not stock pay.
The company paid $174.0 billion to buy back shares and $10.4 billion in dividends over the period.

summary: From fiscal 2010 to 2025, Meta Platforms, Inc. reported $1,064.7 billion of revenue and $309.7 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $102.2 billion, which leaves $207.4 billion of owner cash: 19.5% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 1 of 16 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-09-30 it was 0.7% of revenue.
